description: This file implements the IcmpReachable class for handling ICMPv6 reachability checks via raw sockets, including socket setup, event handling, and ICMP packet processing.

classes.name: IcmpReachable
classes.description: Class for managing ICMPv6 reachability checks using raw sockets, including socket setup, event handling, and ICMP packet processing.

classes.name: IcmpReachable::EpollCallback
classes.description: Nested class handling socket events for IcmpReachable.

methods.name: IcmpReachable
methods.description: Constructor initializing ICMP reachability check with source/destination addresses, timeout, kernel interface, event loop, and stats interface.

methods.name: ~IcmpReachable
methods.description: Destructor closing sockets and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes raw sockets, sets socket options, registers socket with event loop, and prepares ICMP packet headers.

methods.name: OnEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming ICMP responses, parses packets, and updates reachability status.

methods.name: OnAlarm
methods.description: Sends ICMP echo request packets and resets alarm for next check.

methods.name: StatusName
methods.description: Returns string representation of ICMP reachability status.

methods.name: EpollCallback::OnSocketEvent
methods.description: Handles socket events, triggers ICMP response processing, and re-notifies event loop if needed.
